mapper.delete: DELETE FROM WORKDAYS WHERE FUNDID = #{fundid} AND WORKDATE = #{workdate}
mapper.select: SELECT FUNDID, WORKDATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(WORKDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') WORKDATEFMT, WORKFLAG, DECODE(WORKFLAG,'Y','工作日','节假日') WORKFLAGNM FROM WORKDAYS WHERE FUNDID = #{fundid} AND WORKDATE = #{workdate}

SELECT ROWNUM WORKDAYID, FUNDID, WORKDATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(WORKDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') WORKDATEFMT, WORKFLAG, DECODE(WORKFLAG,'Y','工作日','节假日') WORKFLAGNM FROM WORKDAYS WHERE WORKFLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY FUNDID,WORKDATE DESC
SELECT IBF_GET_CURRENT_WORKDATE(#{apkind}) AS WORKDATE FROM DUAL

choose.when: SELECT IBF_GET_NEXTNWORKDAY3( #{sp.cycleendt},0,'******') AS WORKDATE FROM DUAL
choose.otherwise: SELECT IBF_GET_NEXTNWORKDAY3( #{sp.cycleendt},#{sp.nextn},'******') AS WORKDATE FROM DUAL
